contract.title: Contract
contract.exportHint: Approved changes decided in the period, as line items. Totals stay per currency.

pricing.rateCardsHint: Org-level role rates estimators price from. Cards that already priced an impact cannot change rates.
pricing.staffOnly: Rate cards and templates are visible to agency staff.
pricing.templatesHint: Reusable line items with contingency and optional tax lines.
pricing.deleteConfirm: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
pricing.totalComputedOnSave: The total is computed on save from hours x card rates.

policy.title: Approval policy
policy.blurb: Amount thresholds pick the decision rule for each package automatically. Rules are evaluated in order; the first ceiling at or above the priced impact wins. A per-send choice overrides these thresholds.
policy.empty: No thresholds — every package uses “any approver decides”.
policy.hintANY: The first recorded vote decides the package.
policy.hintALL: Every approver must approve; one rejection or change request decides it.
policy.hintSEQUENTIAL: Approvers vote in the listed order, one at a time.
policy.ascendingError: Ceilings must ascend; the last rule may cover any amount.
policy.stepUpBlurb: Extra identity checks on this project's review links. Inherit follows the workspace default; this confirms who is deciding — it is not an e-signature.
policy.deemedBlurb: Days after sending an acceptance package before silence counts as acceptance. Recorded with the policy actor — never as a client decision. Blank disables deemed acceptance (packages expire instead).
policy.deemedError: Enter 1–90 days, or leave blank to disable.
policy.escalationBlurb: Stalled packages escalate exactly once after the delay below. Either the approvers who still owe a vote get a second nudge (whoever's turn it is, when sequential), or the agency leads are told the package is stalled. Blank disables escalation.
policy.escalationError: Enter 1–720 hours, or leave blank to disable.
policy.localeBlurb: Language for logged-out client review links on this project. Inherit follows the workspace default.

options.title: Proposal options
options.blurb: Priced alternatives the client picks between (2–4, or none). Each option needs its own price and effort; the client's pick becomes the change's effective impact.
options.empty: No options — the client decides the impact assessment above.
options.frozen: Frozen: the client already decided on these options.
options.removeConfirm: Remove this option? The client will no longer see it.
options.label: Label

integrations.apiKeysHint: Machine credentials for scripts and integrations. Secrets are shown once and stored hashed. Calls use the same permissions as your workspace, limited to the key's scopes.
integrations.keyExpiresHint: Leave blank for a key that never expires. Prefer short-lived keys.
integrations.secretWarning: This secret will never be shown again. Store it somewhere safe.
integrations.rotateConfirm: Rotate this key? The old secret stops working immediately.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Calls with it will fail immediately.
integrations.staffOnly: API keys and webhooks are visible to owners and admins.
integrations.webhooksHint: ScopeLock signs each delivery with HMAC-SHA256. Verify the X-ScopeLock-Signature header and reject old timestamps. Deliveries retry with backoff; replay any delivery from its log.
integrations.webhookUrlHint: Private and local targets are blocked in production.
integrations.deleteConfirm: Delete this webhook? Pending deliveries are dropped.
integrations.rotateSecretConfirm: Rotate the signing secret? Update your receiver before replaying.

github.title: GitHub linking
github.hint: Connect a repository webhook to trace merged work back to requests. Only identifiers are stored — never code. Merged work with no approved link shows up on the Health page.
github.optIn: Enable external integrations for this project
github.optInHint: Connections and webhooks stay off until this is enabled.
github.webhookUrlHint: Add this as a repository webhook (application/json, pull_request + push events) with the secret below.
github.secretWarning: Enter this secret in the GitHub webhook settings. It will never be shown again.
github.rotateSecretConfirm: Rotate the webhook secret? Update the GitHub webhook before deliveries resume.
github.disconnectConfirm: Delete this connection? Observed work stays as evidence.
github.noWork: No work observed yet. Deliveries appear here once the webhook fires.
github.staffOnly: Connections are managed by project staff.

channels.prefsHint: Approval requests, decisions, escalations, and reminders reach you through these channels. SMS and WhatsApp need a phone number.
channels.phoneHint: E.164 format, e.g. +8801712345678. Used for SMS and WhatsApp only.
channels.slackHint: Post approval requests, decisions, escalations, and reminders to a shared channel via an incoming webhook.
channels.slackUrlHint: From Slack: channel settings > Integrations > Add an incoming webhook.
channels.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Slack? No further posts will be sent.
channels.staffOnly: Slack is configured by owners and admins.
